run_SlurmPipelineExecutor: run the SlurmPipelineExecutor to submit a datatrove pipeline job on a Slurm cluster
build_SlurmPipelineExecutor: build a SlurmPipelineExecutor with a JsonlReader and JsonlWriter pipeline for dataset download
create_JsonlReader: create a JsonlReader that reads JSONL data from a HuggingFace dataset with glob pattern filtering
create_JsonlWriter: create a JsonlWriter that writes processed records to JSONL output files with size limits
run_pipeline: run the datatrove pipeline with SlurmExecutor to download and process MNBVC Chinese dataset
